builds.summary: JDM 1994 Supra RZ (JZA80, V160) in Calgary with a BorgWarner S364 single turbo (HKS exhaust manifold/downpipes/intercooler/cam gears), Link ECU, 1400cc injectors, flex fuel; E85 at 19-20 psi (seller): 667.9 hp @ 6,190 rpm and 588.5 ft-lb @ 5,661 rpm on a Mainline DynoLog at Zee's Garage, 9 Jun 2023, sheet prints 'Correction: 18.7 SAE J607 (26.8°C, 886 mBrA, 41%)' at about 1,050 m altitude. Closest candidate on the dyno side, but the engine internals and camshafts are never stated.
builds.whyNotUsable: Criterion 2 not documented: neither the BaT description nor the seller says the bottom end, head and camshafts are stock (they are simply not mentioned; only 'ARP cylinder head fasteners' and HKS 'camshaft gears' are listed). Also: turbo only named 'BorgWarner S364' (S300SX-E variant not stated; flow figure below assumes S364SX-E); boost comes from a seller comment, not the sheet; intake and rear exhaust not listed. Usable only if the owner accepts 'no internal/cam parts listed' as stock.

builds.summary: US 1997 Supra Turbo 15th Anniversary 6-speed, Sound Performance single-turbo conversion (2022-23): Precision 6466 BB T4 divided 1.0 A/R on an SP manifold, SP intake manifold, 1260cc injectors, ETS 4-inch FMIC, ProEFI flex fuel; Sound Performance confirmed 'definitely a stock bottom end'. builds.whyNotUsable: Criterion 6: the only published dyno record is a Mustang PowerDyne screen capture with no correction standard and no test-day weather. Dyno make is on the screen but the screen labels the traces 'Eng Power'/'Eng Torque' (the owner's build list calls the same numbers 'whp'/'wtq').
